payload.title: In the EntityManager form the adapter names the entity by the argument's identifier text, so an aliased import (import { Subscription as Sub }) is looked up as 'Sub', matches no tenant entity, is recorded with entityName Sub and crossTenant null and yields no finding, whereas the Repository<X> form resolves the entity through the type checker.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:424-432 (the manager form takes target.text and only for a plain identifier)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:407-410 (the repository form resolves the entity from the checker's receiver type)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:498-504 (the entity map is keyed by the declared class name)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:313 (a call whose entity is not tenant-owned returns before any finding)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/handlers/auth-admin-nats.handler.ts:90 (the repo does alias entity imports, so the shape occurs)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.test.ts:405-415 (the manager rows use declared names only, no aliased or namespace-qualified row)
payload.rule_violated: Single method for one fact (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 1 or 2): the entity of a call is resolved by the checker in both forms.
payload.notes: A file that imports an entity under another name and calls manager.findOne(Alias, ...) or manager.delete(Alias, ...) without a tenant predicate is a silent miss (no finding, an observation with entityName Alias), and a namespace-qualified entity such as manager.find(Entities.Subscription, ...) fails the isIdentifier test and is not a boundary at all. No aliased manager-form call exists at this revision, so the hole is latent. Close condition: Resolve the first argument through the checker (the symbol of getTypeAtLocation or the aliased symbol's declaration) and accept property-access arguments; add manager-form rows for an aliased import and a namespace-qualified entity that expect the same finding as the plain name. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 4). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
